data.title: Dilli Diwali Mela
data.description: Celebrate the Festival of Lights at the grandest Diwali Mela in North India. Enjoy 200+ stalls of artisanal crafts, street food, folk performances, fireworks, and cultural showcases spanning three vibrant evenings.

data.title: Hollywood Monsoon Night — Los Angeles
data.description: An unforgettable evening of live music performed by A-list playback singers under the open Mumbai sky. Featuring chart-toppers from the last three decades with a stunning light show and pyrotechnics.

data.title: World Tech Summit
data.description: A premier technology conference bringing together 500+ industry leaders, startup founders, and engineers for two days of keynotes, workshops, and networking. Topics include AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, and the future of the Indian tech ecosystem.

data.title: Bangalore Startup Connect
data.description: A dynamic networking event for entrepreneurs, investors, and startup enthusiasts. Participate in pitch sessions, panel discussions, and networking opportunities with industry leaders from across India.

data.title: Goa Beach Carnival
data.description: Experience a weekend of music, dance, food, and beachside entertainment. Enjoy live performances, water sports, and cultural festivities at Goa's most exciting carnival.

data.title: Arijit Singh Live in Kolkata
data.description: An enchanting evening featuring chart-topping hits and soulful melodies performed live by one of India's most celebrated singers. Expect a world-class audio and visual experience.
